title: nousergon-data features/{date}/fundamental.parquet -- columns crucible.data.point_in_time reads (v1)
description: Column-name/dtype contract for the 11 fundamental-group columns crucible.data.point_in_time.PointInTimeSource actually reads from nousergon-data's CATALOG-governed feature-store snapshot (grep-verified against crucible/data/point_in_time.py::FUNDAMENTAL_FIELD_COLUMNS keys, 2026-09-14). Each key here is a features/registry.py::FeatureEntry.name in nousergon-data, all in that repo's GRANDFATHERED_BARE_FIELDS (bare -- pre-dates the units-suffix contract, alpha-engine-config#10781/#9772). Pinned copy per the P-07 pattern (metron-PR457, crucible-PR302): nousergon-data has no importable dependency into crucible, so this file -- not a live schema fetch -- is the coupling. If nousergon-data renames a column (adds a units suffix, per its own new-field rule) or changes its declared dtype, re-pin this file AND crucible/data/point_in_time.py::FUNDAMENTAL_FIELD_COLUMNS in the SAME crucible PR, or this contract goes stale silently.
